description: In the base game, bringing cargo to a warehouse earns nothing until it reaches its final destination. With this mod, when your warehouse takes over cargo, its owner pays you a handling fee per item, based on how much the warehouse is used this year. The first 730 items a year pay the warehouse's yearly maintenance (break-even at 50% usage), the next 438 items pay a profit margin on top (80% usage), and more items pay nothing. The fee follows the maintenance, so every module raises it: in 1960 a specialized module adds about 219 per item, a general storage module half of that. A full truck of 22 items at a one-module warehouse pays about 4,822. A well-used warehouse pays for itself and makes a small profit; an idle one only costs money. The full price is still paid at the final destination. Each cargo item pays the fee only once. The fee is shown above the vehicle and counts as its transport income, so it appears in the vehicle, line and finance statistics. The margin (0%, 10%, 25% or 50%) can be changed in the mod options.
name: Paid Warehouse Deliveries
summary: When your warehouse takes over cargo, its owner pays you a handling fee.
